draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.22, the 82nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 7th of 18 at RB. He lasted until pick 172, well after his grade rank (82nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Miles Sanders. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (10th percentile). College production: 1,366 rushing yards in 2022, 8th of 18 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns (practice squad). 34 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (4th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025.
